long_biography.plain_text:
Shipping is a family trade for Paul Walter Hinneberg. His grandfather established the namesake firm in Hamburg. His father Christian and uncle Walter later shaped it into a compact shipbroking house known for containership sales, purchases and newbuilding deals. Paul joined the next generation of brokers, applying that established family market network to transactions with established operators and newer Chinese leasing companies.

Beyond broking, Hinneberg has accumulated formal roles across the family's commercial network. He is majority shareholder of Walter J. Hinneberg GmbH and an authorised representative of a family property-management company. He controls Blue Funnel Line in Britain and chairs a Norwegian offshore-vessel investment company. These positions combine active dealmaking with stewardship of family shipping and property interests.
